live.markdown:
# Why AI visibility matters for your business

You have three ways to move your business into AI answers: passive ranking, reactive scanning, or active page publishing. Which suits your market depends on time, budget, and competition.

# Three approaches to getting found by AI

You have three ways to move your business into AI answers:

**Passive ranking.** You publish content on your site and hope Google and AI engines eventually discover and cite it. This costs little upfront but takes months or years, and there's no guarantee your rivals won't occupy that space first.

**Reactive scanning.** You run a free scan to see where AI answers and Google search send buyers to your rivals instead of you. A scan shows the gap between where you rank and where you need to be. It's a one-time measurement—useful for understanding the problem, but it doesn't close the gap.

**Active page publishing.** You write and publish pages built to answer the questions buyers ask AI and Google. [See what AI tells buyers about your market — and write your way in.](https://reachkit.app/) Weekly market re-measurement shows whether your new pages move the needle. [A page written and published for your site every day, your market re-measured every week.](https://reachkit.app/pricing)

Passive ranking suits businesses with time to wait. Reactive scanning suits businesses that need to know where they stand before deciding what to do. Active publishing suits businesses in competitive markets that need visibility now and want to measure whether their work is moving the needle.

# How to choose the right approach for your market

[A free scan shows where AI answers and Google search send buyers to your rivals instead of you.](https://reachkit.app/) Start there if you're unsure of the gap.

If you're in a market where buyers consult AI before searching Google, passive ranking alone won't close the gap fast enough. Rivals are already moving into those answers.

If you want ongoing visibility—not a one-time snapshot—you need weekly re-measurement to know whether your effort is working. The subscription is €49 per month, VAT included, billed in advance through Stripe.

Choose passive ranking if you have months to spare and few competitors publishing to AI engines. Choose reactive scanning if you need to see the problem before you commit to solving it. Choose active publishing if you're in a competitive market and need to know every week whether you're moving closer to where buyers look.
